name: Band Bicep Curl
description: Strengthens the front of the upper arms: with the band under your feet, curl your hands up to your shoulders, elbows at your sides.

source.title: British Heart Foundation: resistance band exercises
source.note: Standing version. The article also shows each exercise seated on a chair.

setup: Stand with your feet hip-width apart on the middle of the band.
Hold an end in each hand, arms straight down by your sides.
cues: Keep your elbows next to your sides.
Palms face up as you curl.
Easier: curl one arm at a time.

prescription.note: Aim for 2 to 3 sessions a week with a rest day between. If you have a heart condition or high blood pressure, check with your doctor or cardiac rehab team first.

keyframes.name: Arms down
keyframes.cue: Arms straight by your sides holding the band.

keyframes.name: Curl
keyframes.cue: Curl your hands up to your shoulders, palms up.
